goal: Turn the side panel into a toolbar popup laid out like other extensions' popups, keep drafts and runs safe when it closes, and add a secondary 'Manage access' view to change or remove the people already invited to the artifact you're on.

features.description: Clicking the ArtiShare toolbar icon opens a popup with the Share and Lists tabs, instead of a side panel
steps: Run `npm run build:fake` and open the built manifest (.output/chrome-mv3-fake/manifest.json)
See `action.default_popup` set to the popup page, no `side_panel` entry and no `sidePanel` permission, and the same `key` as before (wxt.config.ts unchanged there)
Load the fake build (`npm run dev:fake`) and click the ArtiShare icon in the toolbar
See a popup (not a side panel) with the ArtiShare header, the account pill reading owner@example.com, the Share and Lists tabs, and 'Version …' at the bottom
Make a list, preview and send to one artifact from the popup and see the run finish ('Share finished: …'), as it did in the side panel
In e2e, the `panel` fixture opens the popup page as a tab, and every existing spec (e2e/smoke.spec.ts and e2e/share-ux-fixes/*, from the previous goal) still passes against it

features.description: The popup is sized and laid out like other extensions' popups: fixed width, a header and tabs that stay put, content that scrolls, a footer, and no close button
steps: Open the popup with three saved lists and the Lists tab showing every list expanded
See the popup 380 px wide and no taller than 600 px; the header (logo, account pill) and the Share/Lists tabs stay at the top while only the content below scrolls
See the footer with 'Version …' pinned at the bottom, visible without scrolling
Paste a 120-character email address and a long artifact link: see them wrap or truncate with no horizontal scrollbar
See no 'Close ArtiShare' button in the header (a popup closes when you click away)
Open the popup again: focus is not trapped in a text field, and Tab moves through the header, the tabs, then the form

features.description: The popup picks up the artifact in the tab it was opened over: Artifacts is filled in, and + Current tab adds it
steps: Make https://claude.ai/cowork/cse_01ExampleCoworkSession00?artifact=c0ffee00-1234-4abc-8def-000000000001#example the active tab (in e2e, served by a route so nothing reaches claude.ai)
Open the popup: see Artifacts already filled with https://claude.ai/artifact/QqHHsBLXBfYKJD5NqJ8PeY
Clear Artifacts and click + Current tab: see the same link added once and no error
Make a non-claude.ai page the active tab, reopen the popup: Artifacts is empty, and + Current tab shows 'The current tab is not a claude.ai artifact.'

features.description: Confirmations are shown inside the popup instead of browser dialogs (which can close a popup): deleting a list, sending, and discarding a stopped run
steps: In the Lists tab, open a list and click Delete: see an in-popup confirmation 'Delete the list "…"?' with Delete and Cancel buttons, and no browser dialog
Click Cancel (and, again, press Escape): the list stays. Click Delete then confirm: the list is gone
In Share, preview one artifact and click Send: see an in-popup confirmation stating how many invitations go to how many artifacts; Cancel keeps the preview, confirming starts the run

Stop a run with invites left and click Start a new share: see the in-popup 'Discard this run? The remaining invites will not be sent.' Cancel keeps the stopped run and Resume; confirming opens a fresh Share form
In e2e, no `dialog` event fires during any of this (the fixture's auto-accept is removed from these specs)

features.description: Closing the popup doesn't lose the Share form: the artifacts typed and the lists ticked come back when it reopens
steps: Save lists Alpha and Beta with 'Only these' set to Alpha
Open the popup, type two artifact links into Artifacts, untick Alpha and tick Beta
Close the popup (click away) and open it again
See the same two links in Artifacts, Alpha unticked and Beta ticked, and the Share tab showing
Send a run from that form and let it finish, then click Start a new share: see an empty form with Alpha ticked; close and reopen the popup and see that empty form, not the old draft

features.description: Closing the popup doesn't lose a list being typed or edited, or which tab was open
steps: In the Lists tab, click New list, type a name, two addresses and pick Can edit; don't save
Close and reopen the popup: see the Lists tab open with the new-list form showing that name, both addresses and Can edit
Open a saved list, change its permission without saving, close and reopen: see that list expanded with the unsaved permission and Save / Revert enabled
In Share, click + New list, type one address, close and reopen: see the inline form with that address
Save or Cancel each form: reopening the popup no longer shows the draft

features.description: A restored draft is reconciled with what changed while the popup was closed
steps: In the popup, tick lists Alpha and Beta in Share and close the popup
Delete Beta from another window (open the popup page in a tab) and close that too
Reopen the popup: see Alpha ticked, Beta gone, and no error

Start an unsaved edit of list Alpha, close the popup, change Alpha's addresses from another window, reopen: see the draft kept and the existing 'This list changed in another window' warning with Reload saved

features.description: A preview survives the popup closing, even while it is still loading
steps: Fill Artifacts with two links, tick a list, click Preview and close the popup before the results appear
Reopen the popup: see the preview (loading, then both artifact cards with To invite / Already have access), not the blank form
Close and reopen again: the same preview shows, with Back and Send
Click Back: see the form with the same artifacts and ticks; reopening now shows the form, not the preview

features.description: Closing the popup mid-run doesn't stop the run, and reopening it shows live progress
steps: Send invitations to four addresses including a `slow…` one, and close the popup while the run is going
Wait a few seconds and reopen the popup: see the run view with more addresses Invited than before, still updating
Click Stop, close and reopen: see Stopped with Resume; click Resume and see it finish ('Share finished: …')

features.description: The fake claude.ai can change an invitation's permission and remove it, and has artifacts that start with people already invited
steps: Read the rules at the top of src/claude/fakeShareClient.ts and the README's fake-mode list: they describe an artifact id containing 'Shared' starting with three invitees (one accepted Can view, one pending Commenter, and a `locked…` address that refuses changes and removal because the person joined the organization), and an artifact id containing 'Missing' whose invitation list can't be loaded (not found)
In the popup, preview https://claude.ai/artifact/SharedExampleArtifact01 (or any link whose id contains Shared) with a list holding one new address
See the three seeded people under Already have access, with their permissions

Unit tests show the fake's `changeAccess` updates a person's permission, `removeInvite` removes them, both throw for a `locked…` address and for a 'Forbidden' artifact, `listSharees` throws for a 'Missing' artifact, and the next `listSharees` reflects each change

features.description: The claude.ai client can change an invitation's permission and remove it, using the Share menu's own requests
steps: Read `docs/claude-share-api.md`: PATCH and DELETE `/api/frame/invite/{uuid}/{inviteId}` are listed under the endpoints the extension uses, with their refusals
Read `ShareClient` in src/claude/shareClient.ts: it has `changeAccess` and `removeInvite`, and `listSharees` returns each invitation's id

Run `npm test`: apiShareClient tests (with a stub transport, nothing sent) show PATCH with `{ role: 'reader' | 'commenter' | 'editor' }` and DELETE are sent to the right URL with `X-Frame-CP: go` and the artifact's org

The same tests show a 409 `invitee_joined_org` becomes 'This person joined your organization, so their access is managed in claude.ai.', a 403 'Only the owner can change access', a 404 'The invitation no longer exists', and a 429 a rate-limit error

features.description: On an artifact tab, a quiet 'Manage access' link opens a list of the people already invited to that artifact
steps: Make https://claude.ai/artifact/SharedExampleArtifact01 the active tab and open the popup
See a small 'Manage access' link at the bottom of the Share tab, under the Share form or the run view (a secondary link, not a tab or a primary button)

Click it: see a 'People with access' view naming the artifact's link, with a Back button, 'You (owner)' first and not editable, then each invitee with their address, a Pending or Accepted label and their permission
Click Back: see the Share form with whatever was typed before still there
Make a non-artifact page the active tab and reopen the popup: see no 'Manage access' link

features.description: In Manage access, changing a person's permission saves it on claude.ai
steps: Open Manage access on a 'Shared' artifact
Change the accepted Can view person to Can edit
See the select disabled briefly, then a short 'Saved' next to that row, and no other row changed
Close and reopen the popup and open Manage access again: see that person at Can edit
Preview the same artifact from Share: see them under Already have access at Can edit

features.description: In Manage access, removing a person's invitation asks first, then removes it from claude.ai
steps: Open Manage access on a 'Shared' artifact and click Remove on the pending Commenter
See an in-popup confirmation 'Remove … from this artifact? Their invitation will stop working.' with Remove and Cancel
Click Cancel: the person stays. Click Remove again and confirm: the row disappears
Close and reopen the popup and open Manage access: they are still gone
Preview the artifact from Share with a list containing that address: they are now under To invite

features.description: When claude.ai refuses a change or removal, or the list can't be loaded, Manage access says why and leaves things as they were
steps: In Manage access on a 'Shared' artifact, change the `locked…` person's permission: see the select go back to its old value and an error on that row ('This person joined your organization, so their access is managed in claude.ai.'); other rows still work
Click Remove on the `locked…` person and confirm: see the same error on the row and the row kept
Open Manage access on an artifact whose id contains 'Forbidden': see the people listed, and any change shows 'Only the owner can change access'
Open Manage access on an artifact whose id contains 'Missing': see the error ('Artifact not found' or similar) with a Retry button instead of an empty list; Retry asks again

features.description: Manage access handles an artifact with nobody invited, a list that changed meanwhile, and repeated clicks
steps: Open Manage access on a new artifact nobody was invited to: see 'Only you have access.' with a hint that Share invites people
Click Refresh after sending invitations to that artifact from Share: see the new people appear
Click Remove and confirm twice quickly, or change a select twice quickly: see only one request per action (controls are disabled while it's in flight) and no error
While a run is sending to this artifact, open Manage access: see a note that a share is in progress and that Refresh shows the latest

features.description: README, store listing, website and contributor docs describe the popup and Manage access
steps: README: 'click the ArtiShare icon to open the popup' (flowchart, Install step 5, Use it, Develop), that drafts and previews are kept when the popup closes and runs continue, a short 'Manage access' section after Watch it run marked as optional, the fake rules for 'Shared' and `locked…`, and the 'never removes anyone' sentence changed to say it only removes someone when you click Remove in Manage access
store/listing.md: description and test instructions say popup; the `sidePanel` permission justification is removed; the single-purpose text mentions managing existing invitations
docs/index.html: no 'side panel' left
CLAUDE.md layout, .claude/commands/harness-work.md and .claude/agents/feature-verifier.md say popup instead of side panel (the e2e fixture name may stay `panel`)
`npm run check` passes (Prettier clean), and `grep -ri 'side panel'` outside harness/progress.md and node_modules finds nothing that describes the current UI

features.description: The README and store screenshots show the popup
steps: Regenerate docs/images/share.png, preview.png and done.png from the fake build's popup (380 px wide), plus a new docs/images/manage.png of Manage access on a 'Shared' artifact
Regenerate store/images/screenshot-1-share.png, -2-preview.png and -3-done.png at the store's 1280×800 with the popup shown
See the README's images and alt text match, and no screenshot shows real email addresses or real artifact ids
